# Thomas F. Officer

Thomas F. Officer is a product designer, software developer, lawyer, and entrepreneur based in New Hampshire. He builds tools for legal professionals and explores AI-native legal work.

## Primary Pages

- Home: https://www.thomasofficer.com/
- Resume: https://www.thomasofficer.com/resume
- Echo case study: https://www.thomasofficer.com/work/echo
- Afterpattern case study: https://www.thomasofficer.com/work/afterpattern
- Blue Ridge Labs case study: https://www.thomasofficer.com/work/blueridgelabs

## Work Summary

- Echo: AI-native note-taking app for writers across iOS, Apple Watch, Mac, web app, Chrome extension, and MCP.
- Afterpattern: no-code app builder for lawyers, cofounded by Thomas F. Officer and acquired by NetDocuments in 2021.
- Blue Ridge Labs: fellowship and early Community.lawyer work on referral management for bar associations.
